title: eludite.editor.complete input
description: Show the IntelliSense completion list at the caret (Edit > IntelliSense > Complete Word, Ctrl+Space; typing an identifier character, '.', '(' or '<' runs it with `trigger`). The list comes from the language server; while the server is starting or the solution is loading, from the identifiers in the document's syntax tree, marked as such, until the server answers. A new call cancels the previous request for the document; a result for an older document version or solution generation is dropped.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

line.description: 1-based line to move the caret to first.

column.description: 1-based column (characters) to move the caret to first; 1 when omitted.

trigger.description: The character just typed that triggered completion. Omit for an explicit request (Ctrl+Space).
